sloka: भवान् क्रिया परो लोके भवान् देव परायणः ।आस्तिको धर्म शीलः च व्यवसायी च राघव ॥४-२७-३५॥
transliteration: bhavān kriyā paro loke bhavān deva parāyaṇaḥ ।āstiko dharma śīlaḥ ca vyavasāyī ca rāghava ॥4-27-35॥

translations.english: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.
